brief: 5 no-code tools that run an entire SaaS without an engineer on staff.

slots.desc1: Build production web apps with visual programming and built-in databases.
slots.desc2: Design, build and launch responsive marketing sites with a visual CMS.
slots.desc3: Relational data backend that feels like a spreadsheet but scales like SQL.
slots.desc4: Automate workflows between apps using visual scenarios and webhooks.
slots.desc5: Collect payments, manage subscriptions and send invoices globally.

slots.toolTagline: The full-stack visual builder for real software.
slots.bigStatement: Launch complex SaaS products with zero code and production scale.
slots.use1Body: Design responsive interfaces with reusable components and dynamic data.
slots.use2Body: Create relational tables, privacy rules and API endpoints visually.
slots.use3Body: Deploy to a live URL, then optimize with built-in analytics and version control.

slots.toolTagline: Design-driven marketing sites that convert visitors.
slots.bigStatement: Own your brand story with pixel-perfect design and a visual CMS.
slots.use1Body: Publish high-converting pages without waiting on engineering sprints.
slots.use2Body: Let marketing edit CMS items directly without touching the design.
slots.use3Body: Get fast global CDN, clean HTML and automated sitemaps out of the box.

slots.toolTagline: A relational database your whole team enjoys using.
slots.bigStatement: Power user data, content and ops with linked records and automated views.
slots.use1Body: Store profiles, subscriptions and activity in linked tables with custom types.
slots.use2Body: Build filtered dashboards for support, sales and onboarding workflows.
slots.use3Body: Connect to Webflow, Bubble and Make via native integrations and webhooks.

slots.toolTagline: Visual automation that replaces backend engineering.
slots.bigStatement: Orchestrate APIs, webhooks and files with drag-and-drop logic branches.
slots.use1Body: Pipe data between Stripe, Airtable and your app without writing endpoints.
slots.use2Body: Run nightly reports, cleanup jobs and reminder sequences on a timer.
slots.use3Body: Add filters, aggregators and rollback steps to keep data consistent.

slots.toolTagline: The financial infrastructure for internet businesses.
slots.bigStatement: Collect global payments with hosted checkouts and subscription portals.
slots.use1Body: Charge cards, send invoices and manage trials through no-code plugins.
slots.use2Body: Define plans, prorations and usage-based tiers inside the dashboard.
slots.use3Body: Fire webhooks to Make or Bubble when payments succeed, fail or renew.

slots.toolTagline: Automated email journeys that drive retention.
slots.bigStatement: Onboard, nurture and retain users with behavioral triggers and visual journeys.
slots.use1Body: Send timed onboarding tips when new users sign up inside Bubble.
slots.use2Body: Announce features and drive upgrades with segmented audience lists.
slots.use3Body: Trigger campaigns from Stripe events or Airtable tags via native sync.

slots.body: Combine these six tools to launch, bill and scale a software company from your laptop.
